findings.title: worktree_prepare runs the operator's command with the driver's walk-loop stdin, so a prompting bootstrap silently eats the task list
merge passes `<id>-merge` as ORCHID_TASK and log slug, contradicting the documented "task id" contract and `<task>.log` path
PROTOCOL.md's "Every checkout this protocol creates gets a preparation step" is untrue of the integration checkout `orchid start` creates
on a merge prepare failure the driver still points the operator at `.orchid/reviews/<id>-merge.log`, which is absent or stale for that failure
